form_fields.name: monitor_namesrv
form_fields.label: NameServer 地址
form_fields.description: NameServer 地址，格式 host:port。多个地址用英文逗号分隔。
form_fields.description_en: NameServer addresses in host:port form. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
form_fields.guide_short: NameServer 地址，格式 host:port，默认端口 9876。多个地址用英文逗号分隔。采集节点需要能访问其中至少一个地址。
form_fields.guide_short_en: NameServer addresses in host:port form, commonly on port 9876. Separate multiple addresses with commas. The collector node must reach at least one address.

rules.message: 请填写 host:port，多个地址用英文逗号分隔
rules.message_en: Enter host:port. Separate multiple addresses with commas.

form_fields.name: monitor_broker_addr
form_fields.label: Broker 地址
form_fields.description: 注册地址从采集节点不可达时，填写可连通的 Broker 地址。留空则使用注册地址。
form_fields.description_en: Enter a reachable Broker address when the registered address cannot be reached. Leave empty to use the registered address.
form_fields.guide_short: 仅在 NameServer 中登记的 Broker 地址从采集节点不可达时填写，格式 host:port，例如 10.0.0.8:10911。留空则使用注册地址。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Fill this only when the Broker address registered in NameServer cannot be reached from the collector node. Use host:port, for example 10.0.0.8:10911. Leave empty to use the registered address.

rules.message: 请填写一个 host:port，或留空
rules.message_en: Enter one host:port, or leave this empty.

form_fields.name: access_key
form_fields.label: 访问密钥
form_fields.description: 集群开启访问控制时填写。未开启时留空。
form_fields.description_en: Required only when access control is enabled. Leave empty otherwise.
form_fields.guide_short: 集群开启访问控制时与密钥成对填写。未开启时留空。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter this together with the secret key when access control is enabled. Leave both empty otherwise.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密钥
form_fields.description: 集群开启访问控制时填写。未开启时留空。
form_fields.description_en: Required only when access control is enabled. Leave empty otherwise.
form_fields.guide_short: 集群开启访问控制时与访问密钥成对填写。未开启时留空。不要带入首尾空格。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter this together with the access key when access control is enabled. Leave both empty otherwise, and omit leading or trailing spaces.

form_fields.name: response_timeout
form_fields.label: 超时时间
form_fields.description: 单次采集请求的超时时间，超过该时间视为失败
form_fields.description_en: Timeout for one collection request. A request that exceeds this time is treated as failed.
form_fields.guide_short: 单次采集请求的最大等待秒数，默认 10，最小 1。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Maximum wait for one collection request, in seconds. The default is 10 and the minimum is 1.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: 采集周期，单位秒，默认 60，最小 30。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Collection interval in seconds. The default is 60 and the minimum is 30.
